NOR TØMRER & MALERTJENESTER AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2023-10-12, registered in Nesodden.
It reported revenue of NOK 1.26M for 2025 and an operating loss of NOK 5,090 (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of -0.4% and negative equity of -NOK 82,940 (liabilities exceed assets).

NOR TØMRER & MALERTJENESTER AS is led by board chair Noran Hajdari.
The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2023-11-08.
NOR TØMRER & MALERTJENESTER AS has 1 registered workplace.
